title: Relevant context
summary: Retrieve high-signal evidence when needed instead of loading the whole project.

sections.label: Proposed practice
items: Begin with a compact task brief and affected module map.
Retrieve relevant source passages, decisions, symbols, files, and tests.
Return compact tool output with identifiers for follow-up reads.
Preserve applicability, negative evidence, and unresolved requirements.
Compact long sessions using explicit checkpoints and artifact links.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The context contains enough evidence for the decision without unrelated repository/wiki material. Smaller context is useful only when necessary meaning remains intact.

catalog.applicability: Use when preparing the context for an agent task, so that it holds a compact brief, the affected module map and the relevant passages, decisions, symbols and tests instead of the whole repository or wiki. A smaller context is useful only while the necessary meaning stays intact.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
